{{dablink|For other uses of the word "trap," see [[Traps]].}}

A '''mindtrap''', known in the [[Old Tongue]] as a '''''cour'souvra''''', is a device used to trap a [[Channeler|channeler's]] soul. The name closely resembles the French words '''''coeur s'ouvre''''' which translates as "heart opens," possibly a reference to the mezzo-soprano aria "Mon cœur s'ouvre à ta voix" ("My heart opens itself to your voice").

==Description==

A mindtrap is constructed of crystal and wire. It is only possible to activate it in [[Shayol Ghul]], using the blood and saliva of the channeler, due to the malleability of reality there. Using a ''cour'souvra'', the victim's soul, or at least the essence of it, is trapped. The victim can feel it trapped in the ''cour'souvra'' and know when someone is touching it.{{ref/book|9|35}} The holder of the person's ''cour'souvra'' has complete control over that person. Should the ''cour'souvra'' be crushed, that person will become a mindless puppet, subject to the will of the holder.

Channeling in the presence of the ''cour'souvra'' in which you are trapped is very painful; the nearer, the greater the pain. It is not known if a mindtrap is a type of ''[[ter'angreal]]'' or not. Nevertheless it seems to be more aligned to the [[True Power]] than to the [[One Power]].

It is also unknown if [[Moghedien|Moghedien's]] mindtrap is still functioning after the re-sealing of the [[Bore]] by [[Rand al'Thor]]. If so she will live a very peculiar life as a [[damane]]: her ''cour'souvra'' is likely to be sequestered by the [[sul'dam]] responsible for her training, and she will be obliged to explain to them its function, in case they break it without realising the consequences.

==Uses==
[[Cyndane]] and [[Moghedien]] were mindtrapped by [[Moridin]].{{ref/book|7|25}}{{ref/book|8|p}}
